test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 12 men can complete a work in 6 days working 4 hours per days. If 4 men work 8 hours per day, then in how many days the same work will be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

12 men can complete the in 6 days working 4 hours per day

**Formula used:**

{M₁× D₁ × T₁over W₁}={M₂ × D₂ × T₂over W₂} Where, M = man, D = Days, T = Time, and W = Work

**Calculation:**

Let the 4 men can complete the work in X days with 8 hours work per day

According to the question

⇒ {12× 6 × 4}={4 × X × 8}

⇒ 12 × 6 = X × 8

⇒ 72 = 8X

⇒ X = 9 days

**∴ The required result will be 9 days.**
